值为1时正常,值为0时异常,没有相应的自检id时说明此项还未进行检查(可能是时机: When the value is 1, it is normal; when the value is 0, it is abnormal. If there is no corresponding self-check ID, it means that this item has not been checked yet (maybe the timing has not come yet).
带*号项对性能有影响，仅供调试时使用: Items marked with * have an impact on performance and are only used for debugging

勾选后然后【保存】，重启后生效!: After checking, click [Save] and it will take effect after restarting!
